name: tool-split-stream
opens_with: (agent script only — no keystroke opens it)
notes: The 2026-10-09 live audit complaint 3, reproduced first-hand on the deployed binary: a provider interleaving content deltas around a tool_call delta split the word AG|ENTS.md across the tool row ('I'll read the first 5 lines of AG' / [tool row] / 'ENTS.md and summarize.'). The regression gate is the contiguous 'AGENTS.md and summarize.' row: on the pre-fix code ToolStart flushed mid-response and the seam rendered as two messages, so the joined string never appears on screen. ToolComplete is the iteration boundary — its flush keeps consecutive responses as separate messages (pinned by tool_complete_boundary_must_flush_iteration_text) while ToolStart no longer flushes (pinned by tool_start_mid_stream_must_not_split_assistant_text).
